The local awk does not support gawk-style array capture, so the call-count analysis must use a different approach.

A bash script will replace the gawk approach. It will iterate over internal symbols from /tmp/internal_funcs.txt and count grep hits per function, excluding the definition line. Method calls will be counted separately via the .MethodName( pattern.

args.command:
ROOT=/bench/repo
GOFILES=$(find $ROOT -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" ! -path "*/proto/gen/*" ! -path "*/web/*")

# For each internal func, count inbound references
> /tmp/fanin_results.txt
while IFS='|' read -r file name; do
  def="$ROOT/$file"
  pkgdir=$(dirname "$def")
  pkg=$(grep '^package ' "$def" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
  # patterns: pkg.name( and .name( for methods, unqualified name( in same dir files
  c1=$(echo "$GOFILES" | xargs grep -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])${pkg}\.${name}[[:space:]]*\(" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^${def}:" | wc -l)
  c2=$(echo "$GOFILES" | xargs grep -E "\.${name}[[:space:]]*\(" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^${def}:" | wc -l)
  c3=0
  if [ "$name" != "${name^}" ]; then :; else
    same=$(find "$pkgdir" -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -print)
    c3=$(echo "$same" | xargs grep -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])${name}[[:space:]]*\(" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^${def}:" | wc -l)
  fi
  # take max of c1+c3 for funcs, c1+c2 for methods - actually sum unique is hard; use c1+c2 as upper bound for methods else c1+c3
  is_method=$(grep -E "^func \([^)]+\) ${name}\(" "$def" >/dev/null && echo 1 || echo 0)
  if [ "$is_method" = 1 ]; then
    total=$((c1 + c2))
  else
    total=$((c1 + c3))
  fi
  echo "$total|$name|$file|c1=$c1 c2=$c2 c3=$c3" >> /tmp/fanin_results.txt
done < /tmp/internal_funcs.txt

sort -t'|' -k1 -rn /tmp/fanin_results.txt | head -35
